blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task. Prompts greatly influence the generation process, but existing detectors focus solely on the generated texts --- supervised methods learn from labeled texts only, and zero-shot methods rely on the text's probability distributions --- ignoring the underlying generation process, which limits their robustness in open-world scenarios. We introduce SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection, a novel framework for detecting AI-generated text that transfers better across datasets. Specifically, we measure the prompt's influence and use it as a discriminative signal. We characterize the prompt's influence by introducing a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) term that captures how much a prompt explains a text. Based on this quantity, SPADE trains one soft prompt per class to amplify the separation, and predicts the class whose prompt best explains the candidate text. Extensive experiments on several benchmarks against various detectors demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets.
blocks.zh: 方便访问大语言模型(LLMs)使得网上AI生成的文本越来越无所不在,使得AI文本检测成为一项关键的任务. 提示对生成过程有很大影响,但现有的探测器只专注于生成的文本 -- -- 受监督的方法只从标注的文本中学习,零镜头的方法依赖于文本的概率分布 -- -- 忽略了基本的生成过程,这限制了它们在开放世界情景中的强性. 我们介绍 SPADE: 爱文本的软提示(Soft Points for Ai-Text Detection),这是一个用于检测AI生成的文本,更好的跨数据集传输的新框架. 具体地说,我们测量这个提示的影响力,并把它作为歧视信号. 我们通过引入Pointwise相互信息(PMI)术语来描述该提示的影响,该术语可以捕捉一个提示解释文本的多少. 基于这一数量,SPADE每个班级训练一个软速率,以扩大分离,并预测其迅速最能解释候选文本的班级. 对照各种探测器对若干基准进行的广泛试验表明,我们的方法是稳健有效的,在分配外数据集方面实现了最先进的(SOTA)性能。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT ( OpenAI et al., 2024 ) , LLaMA ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , or Gemini ( Team et al., 2025 ) have transformed text generation by producing artificial content that is reasonable, fluent, and contextually relevant. This breakthrough has dramatically lowered technical barriers to produce automatically artificial contents, enabling large-scale automated disinformation and phishing campaigns, and academic dishonesty. The proportion of synthetic content has increased in some media, from 1% in 2022 to almost 20% in 2024 ( Brooks et al., 2024 ) , and this trend continues. In practice, prior works focus on two possible formulations of the detection task: model attribution, i.e., identifying the source model ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , and binary classification, i.e, deciding whether a text is human-written or AI-generated ( Solaiman et al., 2019 ; Zellers et al., 2019 ) .
In this paper, we follow the predominant formulation and treat AI-text detection as a binary classification task.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)如GPT(OpenAI等人,2024年),LLaMA(Grattafiori等人,2024年),或双子座(Team等人,2025年),通过生产合理,流利,上下文相关的人工内容,改变了文字生成. 这一突破大大降低了自动生产人工内容的技术壁垒,使得能够进行大规模的自动造谣和钓鱼活动,以及学术上的不诚实。 合成内容的比例在一些介质中有所上升,从2022年的1%上升到2024年的近20%(Brooks等人,2024年),这一趋势仍在继续. 在实践中,之前的作品侧重于探测任务的两种可能的配方:模型归属,即识别源模型(Sun等人,2025年),二进制分类,即决定文本是人文还是AI生成(Solaiman等人,2019年;Zellers等人,2019年).
在本文中,我们遵循主要配方,并将AI文本检测作为二进制分类任务.

blocks.en: LLM generation is inherently conditioned on the input prompt, and different prompts can induce substantially different output distributions and textual characteristics ( Jiang et al., 2020 ) . In practice, recovering the exact generative context of either class is infeasible, as it remains unknown at test time. As a result, existing detectors often conflate prompt-induced characteristics with those intrinsic to LLM generation, leading to inconsistent performance across prompts ( Koike et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM生成在本质上是以输入速率为条件的,不同的速率可以诱导输出分布和文字特征大不相同(Jiang等人,2020年). 在实践中,恢复任一类的确切基因背景是不可行的,因为在试验时仍然未知。 因此,现有的探测器往往将即时引发的特性与LLM生成的内在特性混为一谈,导致各提示的性能不一致(Koike等人,2024年)。

blocks.en:
Most classical detectors do not explicitly account for this conditioning variable. Supervised detectors learn from labeled data using pre-trained models or hand-crafted features ( Guo et al., 2023 ; Verma et al., 2024 ) .
They perform well in-domain ( Macko et al., 2025 ) , but are typically trained on AI-generated texts elicited by a limited set of hard prompts, potentially capturing prompt-specific patterns that hinder generalization to unseen prompts.
On the other hand, zero-shot detectors ( Bao et al., 2024 ; Hans et al., 2024 ) use statistical measures computed from the logits of some scoring models.
They generalize better but rely on scoring models that closely resemble the source models ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , and overlook the influence of prompts on generation distributions by deriving detection signals solely from the generated text.
blocks.zh:
大多数古典探测器都没有明确说明这个条件变量. 监督检测器利用预先训练过的模型或手工制作的特征从标签数据中学习(Guo等人,2023年;Verma等人,2024年)。
它们在域内表现良好(Macko等人,2025年),但通常接受人工智能生成文本的培训,这些文本是由有限的一组硬提示引发的,可能捕捉到阻碍通俗化到无形提示的即时特有模式。
另一方面,零射线探测器(Bao等人,2024年;Hans等人,2024年)采用从一些评分模型的对数中计算出来的统计计量.
它们更能概括,但依赖与源模型(Sun等人,2026年)非常相似的评分模型,并通过完全从生成的文本中获取检测信号,忽略了提示对生成分布的影响。

blocks.en:
Instead, we find that conditioning text likelihood (PMI) on even a generic instruction can substantially improve the separation between AI-generated and human-written texts, and this holds across different language models (see Figure 1 ).
This suggests that the generative context provides discriminative information beyond text likelihood alone.
Based on this, we hypothesize that
each class is characterized by a distinct latent context: AI-generated texts are conditioned on instructions, whereas human-written texts reflect a different, implicit writing context.
blocks.zh:
相反,我们发现,即使是通用指令的文本可能性(PMI)也可以大大改善人工智能生成的文本和人工生成的文本之间的分离,这涉及不同的语言模式(见图1)。
这表明,基因背景提供了超越文本可能性的歧视性信息。
基于这个,我们假设
每一类都有不同的潜在背景: 人工智能生成的文本以指示为条件,而人文文本则反映了不同、隐含的书写背景。

blocks.en: In this line, regeneration-based methods—both supervised ( Mao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2025 ) and zero-shot methods ( Yang et al., 2024 ) —try to bring the conditioning variable to the detection task. They prompt an LLM to regenerate a given text, and then compare the regenerated texts and the given text through features. All of them focus on using a hard prompt, and they use it only to reproduce the text rather than to measure how well it explains the text.
blocks.zh: 在这个线上,基于再生的方法——既监督(Mao等人,2024年;Yu等人,2024年;Hao等人,2025年),又监督(Yang等人,2024年)——试图将调节变量带入探测任务. 它们促使 LLM 重生成给定文本,然后通过特性比较再生成的文本和给定文本. 它们都注重使用硬提示,它们只用它来复制案文,而不是衡量它如何解释案文。

blocks.en: Since the generative context is unknown at test time, and human-written texts have no explicit prompt. We instead address this challenge by learning two class-specific soft prompts that approximate the latent contexts underlying AI-generated and human-written texts, respectively. We term this approach SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection . We further use the log-likelihood ratio under these two learned contexts as a detection score, measuring which class-specific context better explains a given text.
blocks.zh: 由于基因背景在测试时未知,而人文写作的文字没有明确的及时性. 相反,我们通过学习两个具体类的软提示来应对这一挑战,这些提示分别大致反映了人工智能和人文文本的潜在背景。 我们称之为SPADE: Ai-text Detection的软提示。 我们进一步使用这两个学得背景下的日志相似率作为检测分数,测量哪个类特定背景能更好地解释一个特定的文本.

We employ a log-likelihood ratio test between the two trained soft prompts for Human c h c_{h} and AI c ai c_{\text{ai}} . SPADE classifies by selecting the soft prompt whose PMI best explains the candidate text.

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments on two benchmarks (EvoBench and RAID) confirm the effectiveness, robustness, and transferability of SPADE. Additionally, we evaluate the robustness of our method across different LLM backbones and text lengths, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance against several supervised and zero-shot baselines.
In summary, the main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh:
对两项基准(Evo Bench和RAID)进行的广泛试验证实了SPADE的有效性、稳健性和可转让性。 此外,我们评价我们的方法在不同LLM主干线和文本长度上的稳健性,对照几个有监督的零镜头基线实现最新性能。
总而言之,主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce a new formulation of AI-text detection based on learning class-specific soft prompts. • State-of-the-art performance across two benchmarks, particularly at low false positive rates. • Better generalizability in cross-dataset and cross-family while remaining inference-efficient and storage-light, requiring only two learned soft prompts and a frozen backbone.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们采用了一种基于学习班级特异性软提示的AI文本检测的新提法. • 两个基准的最新业绩,特别是低假正率。 • 在跨数据集和跨家庭方面更加普遍,同时保持推论效率和存储灯光,只需要两个学会的软提示和一个冷冻的骨干。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Existing detection methods
blocks.zh: 2.1 现有检测方法

blocks.en: Supervised methods train a classifier to distinguish AI-generated text from Human-written text. Some methods train a BERT-like model on labeled texts Guo et al. (2023) ; Macko et al. (2025) , fine-tune encoders to learn representations that separate the two classes via contrastive learning Rivera Soto et al. (2024) ; Guo et al. (2024) ; Ta et al. (2026) , or train adversarially to improve robustness against perturbation attacks Hu et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2025) . Another line of works trains ensemble-based classifiers using linguistic features Kumarage et al. (2023) and statistical features Verma et al. (2024) ; Basani and Chen (2026) . Although these methods achieve strong performance in-distribution, they often lack robustness against unseen domains and models, and tend to overfit easily Mitchell et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 监督方法训练一个分类器,以区分AI生成的文本与人文文字. 一些方法在标注的文字Guo等人(2023年);Macko等人(2025年)上训练一种类似BERT的模型,微调编码器,通过对比性学习Rivera Soto等人(2024年)来学习将两班分开的表示法;Guo等人(2024年);Ta等人(2026年),或进行对抗性训练,以提高打击扰动攻击Hu等人(2023年);Li等人(2025年). 另一条工程线使用语言特征Kumarage等人(2023年)和统计特征Verma等人(2024年);Basani和Chen(2026年)进行综艺分类。 虽然这些方法在分配中取得了强大的性能,但它们往往缺乏与看不见的领域和模型相对应的强性,而且往往容易过度适应Mitchell等人(2023年)。

blocks.en: Zero-shot methods often use statistical cues to make their decisions. These cues are, for instance, probability-based such as Log-Likelihood ( Solaiman et al., 2019 ) , Entropy ( Gehrmann et al., 2019 ) , Negative log-curvature ( Mitchell et al., 2023 ; Bao et al., 2024 ) , log-likelihood log-rank ratio Su et al. (2023) , Cross-Perplexity ( Hans et al., 2024 ) , normalized temperature sensitivity ( Ma et al., 2026 ) computed from the logits of one or several scoring models. In a real-world scenario, the LLM that generated a given text is unknown and often comes from black-box model, making the extraction of the true logits impossible. Therefore, zero-shot methods need to use some surrogate models to approximate black-box distributions, intuitively lacking robustness to distributional shift between the source and scoring models.
blocks.zh: 零镜头方法往往使用统计提示来决策. 例如,这些提示基于概率,例如Log-Liklihood(Solaiman等人,2019年),Entropy(Gehrmann等人,2019年),负对数曲线。 (Mitchell等人, 2023年;Bao等人, 2024年),类似日志的比例 Su等人(2023年),交叉性 (Hans等人,2024年),常温敏感度(Ma等人,2026年)从一个或几个评分模型的对数计算. 在现实世界的情景中,生成给定文本的LLM是未知的,常常来自黑盒模型,使得提取真对数成为不可能. 因此,零镜头方法需要使用一些代位模型来近似黑匣子分布,直觉上缺乏强性来进行源与评分模型之间的分布转变.

blocks.en: Concurrently, EchoPrompt ( Bao et al., 2026 ) proposed an implicit reward modeling approach ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , amplified by the PMI . Unlike EchoPrompt, SPADE explicitly trains two soft prompts and derives its signal entirely from the prompt by comparing the PMI of the text under two learned soft prompts.
blocks.zh: 同时,EchoPrompt(Bao等人,2026年)提出了隐含的奖励建模方法(Liu等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年),由PMI放大. 与EchoPrompt不同的是,SPADE通过在两个学习到的软提示下比较文本的PMI,明确训练两个软提示并完全从提示中获取信号.

blocks.en: 2.2 Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 2.2 参数有效 微调

blocks.en:
Soft prompting offers an efficient alternative to full fine-tuning by adapting frozen LLMs to downstream tasks, such as summarization ( Liu et al., 2022 ) and sentiment classification ( Wu and Shi, 2022 ) , without requiring manually crafted prompts or updates to the model parameters.
Unlike conventional soft prompting, which steers generation toward downstream tasks, SPADE learns class-specific soft prompts to enhance the discriminative signal shown in Figure 1 for AI-text detection.
blocks.zh:
软提示通过将冷冻的LLMs调整为下游任务,如summarization(刘等人,2022年)和情绪分类(吴和史,2022年),提供了全微调的高效替代方案,而不需要手工制作的提示或更新模型参数.
与引导生成向下游任务的常规软提示不同,SPADE学习了类特异性软提示,以加强图1中显示的用于AI文本检测的区别信号.

blocks.en: LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) is another alternative to full fine-tuning, alongside soft prompts. ImBD ( Chen et al., 2025 ) uses LoRA to tune the model for the detection task. However, LoRA modifies the model’s internal behavior, whereas our method keeps the pre-trained model untouched to study how it responds to a prompt.
blocks.zh: LoRA(Hu等人,2022年)是完全微调的另一种替代方案,与软导电符并列. ImBD(Chen等人,2025年)使用LORA调制模型完成检测任务. 然而,LORA修改了模型的内部行为,而我们的方法使预先训练的模型不受影响,以研究它如何响应一个即时.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We propose SPADE (Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection), a detection framework that learns class-specific soft prompts to distinguish AI-generated from human-written texts. As illustrated in Figure 2 , we train two soft prompts to learn both contexts and perform a log-likelihood ratio to test which of the two soft prompts best explains a given text.
blocks.zh: 我们提出SPADE(Soft Points for Ai-text Detection),这个检测框架可以学习特定阶级的软提示,以区分人工生成的AI与人文文本. 如图2所示,我们训练两个软提示来学习上下文,并进行对日志的比值测试,在两个软提示中,哪一个最能解释给定文本。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Evaluation Metrics

blocks.en: We train and validate on MIRAGE ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , containing both human-written texts and AI-generated texts from 9 families of instruct LLMs across 5 domains and 3 prompt types. MIRAGE proposes two datasets: (1) Disjoint-Input Generation (DIG), each human-written text is paired with a unique AI-generated text from one of the 9 families. (2) Shared-Input Generation (SIG), each 2,384 human-written texts is paired with one AI-generated text per family. For each of 3 random seeds, we draw a train/validation/test split of MIRAGE-DIG, and one split per family for MIRAGE-SIG.

We evaluate on two datasets completely out-of-distribution (OOD) to serve as our primary benchmarks:
(1) RAID ( Dugan et al., 2024 ) , comprising 8 domains, 11 models, and various text perturbations. We restrict RAID to 7 instruction-tuned model, since they are the most widely used, and use the subset sampled by Ma et al. (2026) ; (2) EvoBench ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , comprising 5 domains and 6 model families; to keep the evaluation fully OOD, we remove XSum, which is also part of MIRAGE.

blocks.en: Following prior work, we use AUROC (AUC) ( Mitchell et al., 2023 ; Bao et al., 2024 ) and the true positive rate at a fixed false positive rate of 5% (TPR) ( Hans et al., 2024 ) as our main evaluation metrics. In addition, we report the macro F1-score for all experiments in the Appendix D . On EvoBench, we compute each metric separately per domain on every generator family to avoid any imbalance and report the mean over families; On RAID, we average over all generators within each domain.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 实验和分析

blocks.en: 5.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 and 2 present the overall performance of SPADE with other baselines on EvoBench and RAID, respectively. Crucially, all baselines struggle in low-FPR regime: zero-shot detectors have TPR lower than 50 % 50\% , supervised detectors below 70 % 70\% . Overall, supervised detectors perform better than zero-shot ones, with an average gain of ∼ 9.7 \sim 9.7 AUC on EvoBench and RAID, especially in hard domain where the texts are short (e.g., harmful in EvoBench, see § 5.4 ).
Supervised detectors trained on the same setup as SPADE transfer only partially to cross-dataset (e.g., ImBD reaches 68.7 68.7 TPR on EvoBench but only 22.8 22.8 on RAID). In contrast, SPADE outperforms all supervised methods by 4.8 4.8 – 25.1 25.1 AUC on EvoBench and 8.2 8.2 – 26.4 26.4 AUC on RAID, and maintains a strong TPR score ( 84 84 – 92.9 % 92.9\% ), highlighting its better transferability in cross-dataset. We find consistent results using LLaMA where SPADE outperforms other baselines (details in § 5.2 per backbone). With Falcon, SPADE is competitive on RAID and wins on EvoBench.
blocks.zh:
表1和表2分别列出了环境、环境和环境科学司与埃沃本奇和RAID的其他基线的总体业绩。 关键是,所有基线都在低FPR制度下挣扎:零射线探测器的TPR低于50%50\%,监督探测器低于70%70\%. 总体而言,受监督的探测器的性能优于零射门,Evo Bench和RAID上的AUC平均收益为-9.7\sim 9.7,特别是在文本短的硬域(例如,在Evo Bench有害,见第5.4节)。
接受过与SPADE相同的设置培训的监督检测器仅部分转移到交叉数据集(例如,ImBD在Evo Bench上达到68.7 68.7 TPR,但在RAID上只有22.8 22.8). 相反,SPADE以4.8 — 25.1 25.1 AUC在Evo Bench和8.2 8.2 — 26.4 26.4 AUC在RAID上的表现优于所有监督方法,并保持了强劲的TRP得分(84 84 — 92.9 % 92.9+%),突出其更好的跨数据集可转移性. 我们利用拉美金融厅发现一致的结果,该方案的业绩高于其他基线(详情见第5.2节,每个主干部分)。 与猎鹰,SPADE在RAID上竞争,在Evo Bench上获胜.

blocks.en: We train SPADE on texts from one LLM family in a MIRAGE-SIG and testing it on texts generated by all family models in EvoBench and RAID.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个MIRAGE-SIG中,就来自一个LLM家庭的文本对SPADE进行培训,并测试Evo Bench和RAID中所有家庭模型生成的文本。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , SPADE achieves the best AUC, TPR, and F1 on both benchmarks, outperforming all baselines. Specifically, SPADE outperforms the supervised baselines by 4.9 4.9 – 28.8 28.8 AUC, 21.5 21.5 – 67.1 67.1 TPR, and 10.7 10.7 – 26.8 26.8 F1 on EvoBench, and by 11.6 11.6 – 29.4 29.4 AUC, 21.1 21.1 – 65.2 65.2 TPR, and 11.5 11.5 – 30.9 30.9 F1 on RAID (see Appendix D.2 for the exact LLM-family wise scores and mean scores). This shows that SPADE transfers better than the other supervised baselines across datasets even when trained on a single family with only 500 500 text pairs (see Appendix A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,SPADE在两个基准上都取得了最好的AUC、TPR和F1, 超过了所有基准。 具体地说,SPADE 业绩优于 受监督的基线为4.9 – 28.8 28.8 AUC、21.5 21.5 – 67.1 67.1 TPR和10.7 10.7 – 26.8 26.8 F1在Evo Bench, 以及11.6 11.6 – 29.4 AUC、21.1 21.1 - 65.2 65.2 TPR和11.5 11.5 - 30.9 30.9 F1在RAID(准确的LLM-family智慧分数和中分数见附录D.2)。 这表明,即使在一个仅有500个文本对的单一家庭接受过培训,SPADE也比其他监督基线更好地跨越数据集(见附录A.1)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Backbone and Perturbation Robustness
blocks.zh: 5.2 腰骨和强力

blocks.en: Figure 4 presents the mean performance of SPADE on the two benchmarks with various LLM backbones. We observe substantial variation across backbones, with more recent model families generally yielding stronger performance. Interestingly, model scale alone does not explain the differences: LLaMA-3.2-1B ( 2024 ) outperforms ( + 2.5 +2.5 – 11.7 11.7 TPR) older but larger models (e.g., Falcon-7B ( 2023 ) and GPT-J-6B ( 2021 ) ), and Qwen3.5-4B ( 2026 ) on par with Qwen3-8B ( 2025 ) . This suggests that the quality of the backbone’s pre-training is the main driver of SPADE’s effectiveness. Overall, we expect SPADE to benefit from future advances in backbone quality without requiring any changes to the method itself.
blocks.zh: 图4显示该方案在具有各种LLM主干线的两个基准方面的平均业绩。 我们看到各骨干部门之间差异很大,较近期的模范家庭一般表现更佳。 有趣的是,单是模型尺度并不能解释这些差异:LLaMA-32-1B(2024年)的性能(+2.5+2.5 – 11.7 11.7 TPR)较老但较大的型号(如Falcon-7B(2023年)和GPT-J-6B(2021年)),与Qune3-8B(2025年)相当的Quen3.5-4B(2026年). 这表明,骨干部门培训前的质量是促进农业发展方案效力的主要动力。 总的来说,我们期望该方案能够从今后骨干质量的进步中获益,而无需改变方法本身。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Impact of the backbone on SPADE’s performance, averaged over EvoBench and RAID.
blocks.zh: 图4:主干线对SPADE业绩的影响,平均为Evo Bench和RAID。

blocks.en: The sensitivity to backbone choice is not unique to SPADE, but common to all detectors. Table 3 compares SPADE to other baselines using two additional backbones (LLaMA-3.1-8B and Falcon-7B). A very surprising finding is that complex zero-shot methods (e.g., Fast-DetectGPT, Binoculars) perform substantially better with these two older backbones than with Qwen3-8B. We hypothesize that their degraded performance with Qwen3-8B may stem from differences in model architecture and training, as Qwen3-8B is a more recent hybrid reasoning and instruction-tuned model, potentially altering the likelihood patterns on which these zero-shot methods rely. Regeneration-based methods (e.g, DNA-GPT, RAIDAR, DPIC) remain relatively stable across backbones except for RAIDAR on Falcon-7B-Instruct, where it collapses close to random. With LLaMA-3.1-8B, SPADE remains the best method overall in the main result (see § 5.1 ). With Falcon-7B, Binoculars and NTS are more competitive where SPADE remains the best in AUC ( + 0.4 +0.4 ) but lose in TPR ( − 0.6 -0.6 ).
blocks.zh: 对主干选择的敏感度不是SPADE独有的,而是所有探测器所共有的. 表3利用另外两个主干线(LLAMA-31-8B和Falcon-7B)将SPADE与其他基线进行比较. 一个非常令人惊讶的发现是,复杂的零射门方法(如快速探测GPT,双筒望远镜)在这两个较老的骨干上比在Qune3-8B上表现得更好. 我们假设,它们与Qune3-8B的退化性能可能源于模型架构和培训的不同,因为Qune3-8B是一个较新的混合推理和指令调制模型,有可能改变这些零镜头方法所依赖的可能性模式. 以再生为基础的方法(如DNA-GPT,RAIDAR,DIMC)在骨干间保持相对稳定,但猎鹰-7B-Instruct上的RAIDAR除外,其坍塌程度接近随机. 有了LLaMA-3.1-8B, SPADE仍然是主要结果中的最佳方法(见第5.1节)。 与猎鹰-7B,双筒望远镜和NTS相比,SPADE在AUC(+0.4+0.4)中保持最佳,但在TPR(−0.6-0.6)中却输掉.

blocks.en: Existing detectors are known to be vulnerable to various text perturbations, which can substantially degrade their detection performance ( Krishna et al., 2023 ; Sadasivan et al., 2025 ) . We investigate whether SPADE remains robust when AI-generated texts are deliberately perturbed to evade detection. Figure 5 presents the AUC and TPR of SPADE and the four strongest baselines on RAID under several adversarial attacks. With Qwen3-8B-Base, SPADE achieves the best performance on every attack except paraphrasing ( 82.2 82.2 vs. 83.2 83.2 AUC for ImBD; 40.6 40.6 vs. 42.2 42.2 TPR for DPIC). Over the 11 attacks, SPADE significantly outperforms every supervised baseline, including the strongest one, ImBD ( 95.6 95.6 vs. 93.1 93.1 AUC, p = 0.005 p=0.005 ; 84.4 84.4 vs. 70.3 70.3 TPR, p = 0.008 p=0.008 ; Student’s t t -test over the three DIG seeds). With LLaMA-3.1-8B, SPADE is competitive with the strongest detector Binoculars and outperforms it on 5 attacks (e.g., alternative spelling, paragraph insertion, misspelling, synonym substitution and whitespace), but collapses on zero-width space attacks (which hurt all supervised methods) going from 92.1 92.1 TPR without attack to 22.7 22.7 (details per attack type is presented in Appendix D.3 ).
blocks.zh: 已知现有探测器容易受到各种文字扰动的影响,这可大大降低其探测性能(Krishna等人,2023年;Sadasivan等人,2025年)。 我们调查当AI生成的文本被故意扰动以逃避检测时,SPADE是否仍然坚固. 图5列示了在几次对抗性攻击下,南非开发署的AUC和TPR以及RAID的四个最强基线。 通过Qune3-8B-Base,SPADE在每次攻击中都取得了最佳的性能,除了配音(82.2 82.2 vs 83.2 83.2 AUC for ImBD;40.6 40.6 vs 42.2 42.2 TPR for DIMC). 在11次袭击中,SPADE显著超过每个有监督的基线,包括最强的基准,ImBD(95.6 95.6 vs 93.1 AUC, p = 0.005 p = 0.005;84.4 84.4 vs 70.3 TPR, p = 0.008 p = 0.008;学生T T-测试三颗DIG种子)。 有了LLaMA-3.1-8B,SPADE与最强的探测器Binoculars具有竞争力,在5次攻击(如替代拼写,段落插入,误拼,同义词替代和白空)上表现优于它,但零宽空间攻击(这伤害了所有受监督的方法)的崩溃从92.1 92.1 TPR不攻击到22.7 22.7(每个攻击类型的详情见附录D.3).

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies to independently assess the contributions of the hinge loss and log-likelihood ratio test to SPADE’s performance. Results are given in Table 4.
blocks.zh: 我们进行减产研究,独立评估连锁损失和对数比测试对SPADE性能的贡献。 调查结果见表4。

blocks.en: We compare the regularized hinge loss to a simple cross-entropy loss. Without the contrastive term, the discriminative power of each test statistic drops on both benchmarks: PMI ​ ( x , c ai ) \text{PMI}(x,c_{\text{ai}}) ’s AUC falls by 6.9 6.9 – 36.5 36.5 points and its TPR by 13.4 13.4 – 22.2 22.2 points, and PMI ​ ( x , c h ) \text{PMI}(x,c_{h}) ’s AUC falls by 12.3 12.3 – 16.3 16.3 points and its TPR by 35.7 35.7 – 45.9 45.9 points. Soft prompts learned with a simple cross-entropy perform worse likely because they converge toward a generative optimum rather than a discriminative optimum. Overall, on the LLR, AUC and TPR improves by 2.0 2.0 – 16.0 16.0 and 7.7 7.7 – 37.4 37.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们把正规化的连锁损失比作简单的交叉连锁损失。 没有对照名词,每个测试统计的区别力都会在两个基准上下降: PMI (x, cai)\text{PMI}(x,c_{\text{ai}}) 其AUC降6.9 6.9 – 36.5 36.5分,其TPR降13.4 13.4 – 22.2 22.2分,PMI(x,ch)\text{PMI}(x,c_{h})的AUC降12.3 – 16.3 16.3分,其TPR降35.7 35.7 – 45.9 45.9分. 用简单的交叉交替学来的软提示表现得更糟糕,因为它们趋于基因优化而不是歧视优化。 总体而言,在LLR上,AUC和TPR改进了2.02.0–16.0 16.0和7.7–37.4 37.4.

blocks.en: We compare the log-likelihood ratio (LLR) test, which contrasts the two learned contexts, with scoring a text using a single soft prompt, PMI ​ ( x , c ai ) \text{PMI}(x,c_{\text{ai}}) or PMI ​ ( x , c h ) \text{PMI}(x,c_{h}) . The LLR improves over the best single prompt by 7.0 7.0 AUC and 11.4 11.4 TPR points on EvoBench, and by 5.1 5.1 AUC and 4.2 4.2 TPR points on RAID. These results validate learning two soft prompts rather than one: modeling both classes and contrasting them yields a more accurate and more robust detector.

blocks.en: 5.4 Further Investigations
blocks.zh: 5.4 进一步调查

blocks.en: Existing detectors performance are known to drop significantly when dealing with short text ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . We test SPADE’s robustness by truncating the Writing texts in EvoBench to specific lengths. Figure 6 presents the AUC of SPADE and four different baselines. Interestingly, supervised methods are more robust than zero-shot methods on short text. Zero-shot methods compute a probability-based score that is not optimized for detection and therefore require a substantial longer text to accumulate a reliable score. In contrast, SPADE is optimized to maximize the gap between the two classes, which makes it more robust than the baselines: it reaches 98.2 98.2 AUC at 75 tokens, versus 88.6 88.6 for ImBD and 78.7 78.7 for Binoculars and Fast-DetectGPT.
blocks.zh: 已知现有探测器在处理短文本时性能会显著下降(Wu等人,2024年). 我们通过将Evo Bench的写作文本缩短到具体长度来检验SPADE的坚固性。 图6列出非洲农业发展综合方案的AUC和四个不同的基线。 有趣的是,被监督的方法比短文本上的零镜头方法更有力. 零射法计算出一个不优化检测的概率计分,因此需要相当长的文字来积累可靠的计分. 相比之下,SPADE则被优化,以最大限度地扩大两个类别之间的差距,这使得它比基线更坚固:它以75个符号达到98.2 98.2 AUC,而ImBD为88.6 88.6,Binocules和快速检测GPT为78.7 78.7。

blocks.en:
Existing regeneration-based detectors require regenerating one or several versions of the input text autoregressively limiting their inference speed ( Hao et al., 2025 ) .
For practical purposes, we compare SPADE’s inference speed with the baselines in Table 5 . Our method requires a single forward pass on a batch of two, so it is slower than detectors requiring one forward pass on a single sequence, and faster than Binoculars, which requires two models. Notably, SPADE is much faster than regeneration-based methods ( ∼ 85.1 \sim 85.1 × \times speed-up) while transferring better across datasets.
blocks.zh:
现有的基于再生的探测器需要再生成一个或多个版本的输入文本,自动限制其推论速度(Hao等人,2025年)。
为了实际目的,我们将SPADE的推断速度与表5中的基线进行比较。 我们的方法要求一个单向前传的批次两个,因此它比要求一个前传的探测器要慢,比要求两个型号的双筒望远镜要快. 值得注意的是,SPADE比基于再生的方法(85.1\sim 85.1×\times speed-up)快得多,同时在不同的数据集之间传输得更好.

Previous research ( Wang et al., 2024 ) propose to assess detector performance on languages other than English. To assess our approach in cross-lingual scenario, we follow DetectRL-X (data details in Appendix A ) protocol ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , by training and tuning on a single language and testing on others (details in Appendix E ). Encouragingly, SPADE shows no collapse on high-complexity languages defined by DetectRL-X (e.g., Arabic, Russian, Chinese) where it reaches 94.97 94.97 F 1 B F_{1}^{B} on average, against 95.56 95.56 for medium-complexity ones (e.g., German, French, Spanish, Portuguese). Similarly, transferring from Indo-European to Semitic or Sino-Tibetan languages costs SPADE nothing ( 95.68 95.68 in-language to 95.54 95.54 out-language F 1 B F_{1}^{B} ), whereas Wu et al. (2026) report an average loss of 19.15 19.15 points.
However, SPADE shows its largest performance drop when transferring from English to German ( 64.45 64.45 F 1 B F_{1}^{B} ), despite performing well in the reverse direction ( 99.51 99.51 F 1 B F_{1}^{B} ). We leave further investigation of this asymmetry to future work.
blocks.zh:
以往的研究 (Wang et al., 2024)提议对英语以外语言的探测器性能进行评估. 为了评估我们在跨语言情况下的做法,我们遵循DetectRL-X(附录A中的数据细节)协议(Wu等人,2026年),对单一语言进行培训和调整,并对其他语言进行测试(详见附录E)。 令人鼓舞的是,SPADE在DetectRL-X(如阿拉伯语、俄语、中文)定义的高复杂度语言上没有崩溃,平均达到94.9794.97 F 1 B F_{1}^{B},中等复杂度语言(如德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语)则为95.56 95.56。 同样,从印欧语转向犹太语或中西藏语也使SPADE一文不值(95.68 95.68 in language to 95.54 95.54 ex language F 1 B _{1}^{B}),而Wu et al. (2026)报告平均损失19.1519.15分.
然而,SPADE在从英语转到德语(64.45 64.45 F 1 B _{1}^{B})时表现出最大的性能下降,尽管在反方向表现良好(99.51 99.51 F 1 B F_{1}^{B} ). 我们将对这一不对称性的进一步调查留待未来工作.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented SPADE, a novel detection framework that learns class-specific soft prompts to distinguish AI-generated from human-written texts. Detection is a log-likelihood ratio test between the PMIs conditioned by the soft prompts. SPADE achieves strong performance in cross-datasets and cross-generator compared to both zero-shot and supervised baselines, while remaining inference-efficient. Building on our strong performance in cross-generator scenario, we intend to investigate if SPADE can be adapted to model attribution task. Additionally, since the LLR decomposes into per-token contributions, we plan to investigate at the token level which characteristics is captured.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了SPADE,这是一种新颖的检测框架,它学习特定阶级的软提示,以区分AI生成的和人文文本. 检测是受软提示条件限制的PMIs之间的一个log-likelihood比测试. 与零射线和受监督的基线相比,SPADE在跨数据集和跨生成器上都取得了强效性能,同时仍然具有推论效率. 根据我们在跨源模型中的强效表现,我们打算调查SPADE是否能够适应模型归属任务. 此外,由于LLR分解成每笔捐款,我们计划以象征性的级别来调查其特征。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our findings indicate that using different backbone LLMs can significantly change the performance of all detectors. A more systematic comparison across all baselines would better clarify the impact of the backbone choice on each detector, in particular contrasting SPADE with the other supervised baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,使用不同的主干线LLMS可以显著改变所有探测器的性能. 对所有基线进行更系统的比较,将更好地澄清主干线选择对每个探测器的影响,特别是将SPADE与其他受监督的基线进行比较。

blocks.en: A second limitation is that, like most state-of-the-art detectors, SPADE’s performance drops on AI-generated texts that was paraphrased to evade existing detectors (see Section 5.2 ). Since SPADE is supervised, it can be trained on datasets containing perturbed texts, which we leave to future work.
blocks.zh: 第二项限制是,与大多数最先进的探测器一样,SPADE的性能在AI生成的文本上下降,被解释为避开现有的探测器(见第5.2节)。 由于SPADE受到监督,它可以接受包含扰动文本的数据集培训,我们留待未来工作.

blocks.en: Finally, our evaluation primarily focuses on texts generated by instruction-tuned models. As shown in Table 7 in Appendix B , SPADE performs less effectively on texts from base models. While we leave further investigation to future work, this drop may stem from the exclusive use of instruction-tuned models in training or the weaker influence of instructions on base-model generation.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的评价主要侧重于经指导调整的模型产生的文本。 如附录B表7所示,该方案在基本模型文本方面的执行效率较低。 虽然我们将进一步的调查留给今后的工作,但这种下降可能是由于在培训中专门使用经指导调整的模式,或者指令对基本模型生成的影响较弱。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: We evaluate on publicly available benchmarks for machine-generated text detection (RAID, EvoBench, DetectRL-X and MIRAGE) and use them only for non-commercial research, in line with their intended purpose and licenses (see Appendix A.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价公开公布的机器生成的文本检测基准(RAID、Evo Bench、DetectRL-X和MIRAGE),并按照预定目的和许可证只用于非商业研究(见附录A.5)。

blocks.en: Although SPADE transfers better than the baselines and is practical to deploy thanks to its fast inference and small storage requirements, the prediction itself is not bulletproof. Performance may degrade in specific scenarios, especially regarding calibration on in-domain data. Human judgment remains necessary, especially in high-stakes domains.
blocks.zh: 虽然SPADE的传输优于基线,并且由于其快速推论和小的存储要求而实际部署,但预测本身并不防弹. 性能在特定情况下可能会下降,特别是在对域内数据的校准方面。 人类的判断仍然是必要的,特别是在重大领域。

blocks.en: All models are run with PyTorch 2.10 and Hugging Face Transformers 5.17 in bfloat16, with FlashAttention-2 (flash-attn 2.8.1) for training. Every detector scores at most the first 512 tokens of a text (backbone tokenizer, no special tokens). AUROC, ROC curves and the thresholds (Youden-J, TPR at 5% FPR) are computed with scikit-learn 1.9.1; pAUC@5% FPR is the normalized area under the ROC curve for FPR ≤ 0.05 \leq 0.05 . F1 is the F1 of the AI class at the Youden-J threshold fitted on the MIRAGE validation split.
blocks.zh: 所有型号均使用PyTorch 2.10和hugging Face Transformers 5.17在bfloat16运行,FlashAttention-2(flash-attn 2.8.1)用于训练. 每个探测器最多评分一个文本的前512个令牌(backbone sorderizer,没有特殊令牌). AUROC, ROC曲线和阈值(Youden-J, TPR为5% FPR)用sikit-learn 1.9.1计算; pAUC@5% FPR是ROC曲线下FPR 0.05\leq 0.05的正常化区域. F1是安装在MIRAGE验证分机上的Youden-J阈值的AI级的F1.

blocks.zh: C.1 后骨类型选择

blocks.en: For zero-shot methods, we follow the original implementations with different backbones, keeping each paper’s base/instruct choice where possible. We report in the following table these choices (Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 对于零射法,我们采用不同的主干,尽可能保持每份文件的基础/指导选择。 我们在下表中报告这些选择(表8)。

blocks.en: Table 8: Backbone type used by each baseline.
blocks.zh: 表8:每个基准使用的背骨类型。

blocks.en: C.2 Hyperparameter Selection
blocks.zh: C.2 超参数选择

blocks.en: For hyperparameter selection, we trained for 3 epochs with a batch size of 16 on MIRAGE-DIG, and for 20 epochs on MIRAGE-SIG. We select checkpoints and hyperparameters with pAUC@5% FPR rather than AUC or TPR, because AUC and TPR approach 1 after only a few epochs, which makes them unsuitable for selection. The only tuned hyperparameter is the learning rate, which differs across backbones. Learning rates are selected on MIRAGE-DIG validation (seed 0, pAUC@5% FPR) from {1e-5, 3e-5, 1e-4, 3e-4}, extended to 1e-3 and 3e-3 when the best value lay at the edge of the grid (Falcon-7B only). The selected learning rates are 3e-4 for Qwen3-8B-Base and LLaMA-3.1-8B, and 3e-3 for Falcon-7B. MIRAGE-SIG uses the same learning rate per backbone. Following Lester et al. (2021) , we use a soft prompt of length 64 64 , initialized with the embeddings of random vocabulary tokens.
blocks.zh: 在超参数选择方面,我们在MIRAGE-DIG上为3个批量大小为16个的纪元进行了培训,在MIRAGE-SIG上为20个纪元进行了培训。 我们选择使用 pAUC@5% FPR 而不是 AUC 或 TPR 的检查站和超参数, 因为 AUC 和 TPR 只在几个纪元之后就接近 1, 这使得它们不适合选择 。 唯一的调制超参数是各骨干不同的学习率。 从{1e-5,3e-5,1e-4,3e-4}的MIRAGE-DIG验证中选择学习率(种子0,pAUC@5%FPR),当最佳值位于网格边缘时(仅Falcon-7B)扩展至1e-3和3e-3. 所选的学习率是Qwen3-8B-Base和LLaMA-3.1-8B的3e-4,Falcon-7B的3e-3. MIRAGE-SIG采用每根骨干相同的学习率. 继Lester et al. (2021)之后,我们使用了长度64 64 的软速率,初始化后嵌入了随机词汇符号.

blocks.en: C.3 Zero-shot methods
blocks.zh: C.3 零射法

blocks.en: ( Hans et al., 2024 ) is a zero-shot method based on the ratio between the perplexity and the cross-perplexity that uses two scoring models: an observer and a performer. The cross-perplexity acts as a normalizer measuring whether the tokens are surprising relative to another surrogate model. We use three different model pairs (Falcon-7b / Falcon-7b-Instruct, LLaMA-3.1-8B / LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3-8B-Base / Qwen3-8B).
blocks.zh: (Hans et al., 2024)是一种零射法,基于偏差和跨偏差的比例,使用两个打分模型:观察者和表演者. 与另一个代位模型相比,交叉的复杂度起到衡量这些代位符是否令人惊讶的正常化作用. 我们使用了三种不同的型号配对(Falcon-7b / Falcon-7b-Instruct,LLaMA-31-8B / LLaMA-31-8B-Instruct,和Qune3-8B-Base / Qune3-8B).

blocks.en: ( Bao et al., 2024 ) following DetectGPT ( Mitchell et al., 2023 ) is a zero-shot method using the conditional probability curvature where AI-generated text lives on a local maximum of that curvature. The initial paper uses GPT-J-6B as the sampling and GPT-Neo-2.7B as the scoring models, and the GitHub repository proposes to use LLaMA-3-8B/LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct which is supposed to outperform the previously chosen models. We use three different model pairs (Falcon-7b / Falcon-7b-Instruct, LLaMA-3.1-8B / LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3-8B-Base / Qwen3-8B).
blocks.zh: (Bao等人,2024年)在检测GPT之后(Mitchell等人,2023年)是一种零射法,采用条件概率曲率法,即AI生成的文本生活在该曲率的局部最大值上. 最初的论文使用GPT-J-6B作为采样,GPT-Neo-2.7B作为评分模型,GitHub寄存器建议使用LLaMA-3-8B/LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct,它应该比之前选择的模型要好. 我们使用了三种不同的型号配对(Falcon-7b / Falcon-7b-Instruct,LLaMA-31-8B / LLaMA-31-8B-Instruct,和Qune3-8B-Base / Qune3-8B).

blocks.en: ( Ma et al., 2026 ) is a zero-shot method using a difference between high-temperature and low-temperature scoring on the input text and uses temperature sensitivity as its detection signal. We use three different model pairs (Falcon-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and Qwen3-8B-Base) as our scoring model.
blocks.zh: (Ma等人,2026年)是一种使用高温和低温评分在输入文本上有所区别的零射法,并以温度敏感度作为其检测信号. 我们使用三种不同的型号对(Falcon-7B,LLaMA-31-8B,以及Qune3-8B-Base)作为我们的评分模型.

blocks.en: C.4 Regeneration-based methods
blocks.zh: C.4 基于再生的方法

blocks.en: We generate all regenerated texts of all datasets using vLLM 0.19.1 for efficiency. We carefully choose the three comparison backbones as (Qwen3-8B without thinking, LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Falcon-7B-Instruct) for RAIDAR and DPIC on a single seed 0 0 . As for DNA-GPT, we replace the backbone by their respective base pair (Qwen3-8B-Base, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and Falcon-7B).
blocks.zh: 我们使用 vLLM 0.19.1 生成所有重新生成的数据集文本,以提高效率。 我们仔细地选择三个比较主干线(Quen3-8B,没有思考,LLaMA-31-8B-Instruct,和Falcon-7B-Instruct)作为RAIDAR和DPIC在单种子0 0上的比对. 至于DNA-GPT,我们用各自的碱基对(Qune3-8B-Base,LLaMA-3.1-8B,和Falcon-7B)取代骨干.

blocks.en: We then obtain three splits (train, validation, test) over three different seeds 0 , 27 , 78 0,27,78 using the same document-level splits.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们通过三个不同的种子0,27,78 0,27,78,使用相同的文件级别分裂获得三个分裂(训练,验证,测试).

blocks.en: DNA-GPT ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . We use the the original protocol ( K = 10 K=10 , temperature 0.7). We keep the default values for all other parameters. Since we are computing the score using our own scoring model, we run DNA-GPT in the white-box setting.
blocks.zh: DNA-GPT(Yang等人,2024年). 我们使用原协议(K=10K=10,温度0.7). 我们保留所有其他参数的默认值。 由于我们用自己的评分模型计算得分, 我们运行DNA-GPT 在白盒设置。

blocks.en: RAIDAR ( Mao et al., 2024 ) . We use the same 7 7 7 prompts as in the original paper with the specified temperature 0.7 0.7 like in their paper. We let the other value per default of the backbone model.
blocks.zh: RAIDAR(毛泽东等,2024年). 我们使用与原始纸张相同的7 7 7 速率,如纸张中规定的温度0.7。 我们让另一个值 每个默认的骨干模型。

blocks.en: DPIC ( Yu et al., 2024 ) . We use the same prompt and the same specified temperature 0.2 0.2 like in their paper and vary only the backbone model. We use the same embedding model "Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2-7B-instruct".
blocks.zh: DIC(Yu等人,2024年). 我们使用相同的即时和相同的指定温度 0.2,就像他们的纸张一样, 并且只改变主干模型。 我们使用相同的嵌入型号"阿里巴巴-NLP/gte-Qun2-7B-struct".

blocks.en: C.5 Supervised methods
blocks.zh: C.5 监督方法

blocks.en: We train on the same splits as SPADE so that only the methodology differs.
blocks.zh: 我们接受与SPADE相同的训练,这样只有方法不同。

blocks.en: RoBERTa . We follow the standard training setup for RoBERTa, with a learning rate of 2e-5, 5 epochs and a batch size of 8, and choose the best epoch on the validation set with the same metric, pAUC@5% FPR.
blocks.zh: 罗贝塔。 我们遵循RoBERTA的标准训练设置,学习率为2e-5,5个历程和8个批量大小,并用相同的度量,pAUC@5% FPR来选择最优秀的历程.

blocks.en: ImBD ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Following their implementation, we optimize it as we do SPADE: same split, learning-rate grid search, and the same validation metric, pAUC@5% FPR. The selected learning rates are 1e-4 for Qwen3-8B-Base and Falcon-7B, and 3e-5 for LLaMA-3.1-8B. ImBD on Falcon-7B degenerates at higher learning rates (validation pAUC@5% FPR drops from 0.88 at 1e-4 to 0.37 at 3e-4) so we did not extend the grid.
blocks.zh: ImBD (Chen等人,2025年). 执行之后,我们像SPADE一样优化它:相同的拆分,学习率的网格搜索,以及相同的验证度量度,pAUC@5%的FPR. 所选的学习率是Qune3-8B-Base和Falcon-7B的1e-4,以及LLaMA-31-8B的3e-5. Falcon-7B上的ImBD在高等学率下退化(验证 pAUC@5%FPR从1e-4的0.88下降到3e-4的0.37),所以我们没有扩展电网.

blocks.zh: D.1 总业绩

blocks.en: We report the per-domain results of Section 5.1 with two additional backbone models (LLaMA-3.1-8B and Falcon-7B) for completeness. With LLaMA-3.1-8B, SPADE remains the state-of-the-art in both benchmark EvoBench (Table 11 ) and RAID (Table 12 ). With Falcon-7B, SPADE is competitive with Binoculars and NTS on RAID (Table 14 ) but remains the best overall on EvoBench (Table 13 ). This result is consistent with § 5.2 , where SPADE’s performance drops on less capable and older backbones.
blocks.zh: 我们用另外两个主干模型(LLAMA-31-8B和Falcon-7B)报告第5.1节的每个领域结果,以说明完整性。 与LLaMA-3.1-8B一样,SPADE仍然是基准Evo Bench(表11)和RAID(表12)中最先进的。 与Falcon-7B相比,SPADE在RAID(表14)上与Binocules和NTS具有竞争力,但在Evo Bench(表13)上仍然是最佳的整体. 这一结果符合第5.2节,其中SPADE的性能下降于能力较弱和较老的骨干上。

blocks.en: Appendix F Training Necessity

blocks.en: We report in Table 22 the time and memory needed to train SPADE on MIRAGE-DIG. Training covers the 64,652 training texts (32,326 human/AI pairs) for 3 epochs, with a batch size of 16 and soft prompts of 64 tokens, on a single H100 NVL GPU (94 GB) with FlashAttention-2 and gradient checkpointing. We time one epoch per backbone; epoch times vary by less than 1% across epochs and seeds, so the total is three times the epoch time. Only the soft prompts are optimized ( 2 × 64 2\times 64 embeddings) and the backbone stays frozen.
blocks.zh: 在表22中,我们汇报了为在MIRAGE-DIG上培训SPADE所需的时间和记忆。 培训涵盖3个世纪的64,652个培训文本(32,326人/AI配对),批量大小为16个,软提示64个令牌,单装H100 NVL GPU(94 GB),FlashAttention-2和梯度检查. 我们每个骨干时间为1个划时代;划时代的时间在时间和种子时间之间变化不到1%,所以总数是划时代时间的3倍. 只有软导体被优化(2×64 2\times 64 嵌入),骨干保持冻结.
